name: `initialize`
positive: Exact advertised capability keys, provider options, trigger characters, semantic-token legend, server info, workspace folder support.
negative: Unsupported providers are absent or protocol JSON null; unsupported provider requests return method-not-found and unsupported notifications are no-response no-ops; client capability variations do not change service semantics; notification-shaped initialize messages do not initialize; malformed params reject without initializing; feature requests before `initialize` return server-not-initialized; repeated `initialize` requests are rejected without resetting server state.

name: `initialized`
positive: Notification has no response and may trigger watcher/config setup.
negative: Repeated initialization stays stable without duplicate watcher registration; minimal initialization stays stable.

name: `shutdown`, `exit`
positive: Shutdown response after initialization, clean exit behavior, no pending background publication after shutdown; `exit` remains allowed after shutdown.
negative: `shutdown` before `initialize` returns server-not-initialized without closing the server; notification-shaped `shutdown` does not close the server; request-shaped `exit` reports invalid-request but still exits; requests after shutdown are rejected consistently with invalid-request errors; messages after `exit` are ignored because the server lifecycle has ended.

name: `$/cancelRequest`
positive: Stale queued or expensive requests are discarded by generation/cancellation tokens.
negative: Unknown, malformed, or already-completed request IDs are no-response no-ops and do not poison later requests; request-shaped cancel messages are rejected without cancelling the target ID.

name: `textDocument/didOpen`
positive: Open overlay wins over disk and publishes diagnostics for syntax/HIR/analysis/schema facts.
negative: Missing workspace config, scratch file mode, malformed source, missing schema.

name: `textDocument/didChange`
positive: Full and incremental edits update overlays, versions, line indexes, diagnostics, completions, hovers, semantic tokens.
negative: Out-of-order or stale versions do not publish stale facts; malformed incremental edits reject cleanly.

name: `textDocument/didClose`
positive: Closing removes overlay or restores disk snapshot, clears or refreshes diagnostics, and restores disk-backed query behavior for features such as definition, completion, hover, type definition, semantic tokens, and inlay hints.
negative: If unsupported, stop advertising `openClose`; otherwise add a protocol fixture.

name: `textDocument/didSave`
positive: Capability pins `save: false`; save notifications are no-response no-ops.
negative: Save notifications are not required for correctness while `save` is false.

name: `textDocument/publishDiagnostics`
positive: Parser, HIR, analysis, schema, config, missing import, unused import, and structured repair metadata project to LSP diagnostics.
negative: One-file syntax errors do not block unrelated modules; stale schema degrades to `Any`; deleted files clear diagnostics.

name: `textDocument/completion`
positive: Item, statement, expression, type, member, record field, map key, module path, call argument, lambda parameter, schema, stdlib, builtin, and cross-file imported declaration completions. Must prove structured authoring contexts before item rendering, then include empty-prefix typed receiver `.` completions for source/schema/builtin methods and fields, struct-field declaration body contexts, readable label/detail separation for source and schema types, and `for in`/`match` snippets.
negative: Dynamic receivers suppress member guesses; unknown constructors suppress record fields; struct declaration bodies suppress value/constructor fallback; labels and insert text must not contain unrelated fully qualified path suffixes; stale/cancelled queries discard; malformed cursor contexts recover.

name: `completionItem/resolve`
positive: Lazy docs/details for schema, stdlib, and source-backed items where supported; items without lazy payloads pass through unchanged.
negative: Unknown resolve payloads return an invalid-request error without panics; initial completion list stays lightweight.

name: `textDocument/signatureHelp`
positive: Source functions, source methods, schema functions/methods, trait methods, stdlib functions/methods, active parameter, named/default args, and imported function/method calls.
negative: Unknown calls and dynamic `Any` receiver calls return protocol JSON null; incomplete calls resolve only when target facts exist; stale schema.

name: `textDocument/hover`
positive: Locals, params, declarations, fields, methods, variants, modules, type hints, schema facts, stdlib facts, docs, effects, permissions, and imported source facts.
negative: Unresolved names and dynamic `Any` member targets return protocol JSON null; missing-schema type hints degrade to `Any`; schema facts without source spans and parser recovery remain explicit audits.

name: `textDocument/definition`
positive: Local bindings, source declarations, cross-file imported declarations, imported const/state uses, imported function calls, source fields/methods/variants, schema facts with source spans.
negative: Schema facts without source spans return no false enclosing declaration; dynamic/unresolved targets return no location.

name: `textDocument/declaration`
positive: Source declaration targets, including cross-file imported declarations, where declaration and definition are the same or explicitly distinct.
negative: Must not silently alias unrelated definition behavior for members or type facts; dynamic/unresolved targets return no location.

name: `textDocument/typeDefinition`
positive: Variables, parameters, and member expressions with source/schema type facts jump to source/schema type declarations when source-backed, including imported source types.
negative: Field values such as `cell.value` must not jump to the enclosing function by fallback; builtin/dynamic/unknown types use an explicit protocol JSON null policy.

name: `textDocument/implementation`
positive: No positive coverage until trait/impl implementation semantics are specified.
negative: Capability remains absent or protocol JSON null and direct requests return method-not-found or an explicit unsupported response.

name: `textDocument/references`
positive: Locals, parameters, source declarations, imports, functions, const/state uses, fields, methods, variants, schema-backed source spans, read/write classification, and cross-file uses.
negative: Shadowed locals stay separate; schema-only, builtin, dynamic, unresolved, and missing-schema targets are classified or rejected consistently.

name: `textDocument/documentHighlight`
positive: Same-document highlights for locals, params, functions, fields, methods, variants, schema member calls, read/write/text kind.
negative: Parser recovery, dynamic members, unresolved names, shadowing.

name: `textDocument/prepareRename`
positive: Editable ranges for source-owned locals, private declarations, source members, variants, and source-backed schema spans where allowed.
negative: Reject keywords, literals, schema-only host facts, builtin facts, dynamic `Any`, unresolved names, public ABI risk without metadata, collisions.

name: `textDocument/rename`
positive: Versioned workspace edits for all references of an editable source-owned symbol across defining and importing files, conflict checks, hot-reload risk metadata.
negative: Overlapping edits, stale versions, visibility conflicts, name collisions, schema-only/builtin/dynamic/unresolved targets.

name: `textDocument/codeAction`
positive: Diagnostic-backed typo fixes, missing imports, unused import removal, missing match arms, missing record fields.
negative: Ambiguous imports, dynamic receiver typo fixes, speculative semantic rewrites, stale ranges.

name: `textDocument/prepareCallHierarchy`
positive: Source functions, source methods, trait defaults/interface methods, schema-backed methods with source spans where available.
negative: Non-callable targets, dynamic calls, unresolved targets, schema-only targets without source spans.

name: `callHierarchy/incomingCalls`
positive: Incoming source and typed receiver method calls across modules, source/schema method call ranges.
negative: Dynamic/unresolved calls are not guessed; stale indexes are rejected.

name: `callHierarchy/outgoingCalls`
positive: Outgoing source function/method/schema method calls from selected callable body.
negative: Parser recovery, dynamic calls, incomplete bodies.

name: `textDocument/documentSymbol`
positive: Top-level declarations and nested type/impl/trait members with names, kinds, details, ranges, selection ranges.
negative: Malformed declarations recover where possible without bogus symbol ranges.

name: `workspace/symbol`
positive: Module-qualified source declarations and schema facts, query filtering, workspace roots.
negative: Deleted files, stale indexes, missing schema, duplicate short names.

name: `textDocument/foldingRange`
positive: Imports, declarations, functions, blocks, match arms, multiline literals, nested members.
negative: Malformed braces or incomplete items degrade without panics.

name: `textDocument/selectionRange`
positive: Syntax ancestry ranges for declarations, expressions, members, calls, types, patterns, literals.
negative: Parser recovery and incomplete nodes still return stable parent chains where possible.

name: `textDocument/semanticTokens/full`
positive: Lexical and resolved tokens for declarations, uses, literals, operators, punctuation, provenance modifiers, unresolved references.
negative: Parser recovery, missing schema fallback, client token/modifier fallback projection.

name: `textDocument/semanticTokens/full/delta`
positive: Stable result IDs and deterministic full-replacement or delta behavior after edits.
negative: Stale result IDs, edits that change line indexes, cancelled/stale generations.

name: `textDocument/semanticTokens/range`
positive: Requested range filters full service tokens and encodes valid relative ranges; empty requested ranges return an empty token stream.
negative: Malformed sources and client capability fallback.

name: `textDocument/formatting`
positive: Full-document deterministic formatting, comment/blank-line preservation, final newline, idempotence, compact builtin container type arguments, nested `Option`/`Result` type hints, function signatures, local annotations, and map/set/array examples without formatter-invented type-argument line breaks.
negative: Malformed source, unresolved HIR, syntax-only fallback, incomplete type argument lists, and long lines without an explicit line-width policy.

name: `textDocument/rangeFormatting`
positive: Selected top-level item, nested members, field groups, whitespace-padded selections, trailing whitespace cleanup.
negative: Partial unsupported ranges return conservative edits only.

name: `textDocument/onTypeFormatting`
positive: `}` and newline triggers for completed items, methods, enum record variants, current construct cleanup, and preserving the same compact type-argument spacing as full-document formatting.
negative: Unsupported triggers, incomplete constructs, and incomplete type argument lists fall back safely.

name: `textDocument/inlayHint`
positive: Parameter names, local type facts, lambda parameter facts, host-path type facts, tuple-variant payload names, requested range.
negative: Explicit annotations, unknown/Any facts, dynamic boundaries, missing schema suppress hints.

name: `workspace/didChangeWatchedFiles`
positive: Create/change/delete/rename `.vela`, `vela.toml`, and schema artifact events update project/schema state and diagnostics.
negative: Coalesced duplicate events, missing files, invalid config/schema, deleted schema.

name: `workspace/didChangeConfiguration`
positive: Editor settings map to service-owned workspace config, roots, schema path, reload behavior.
negative: Invalid settings degrade to diagnostics; no protocol types leak into service APIs.

name: `workspace/didChangeWorkspaceFolders`
positive: Added/removed roots reindex modules and republish open diagnostics.
negative: Removed roots clear stale disk facts; open overlays remain authoritative where applicable.

name: `workspace/configuration`
capability: Server request to client, when used
positive: Settings request/response is projected only in `vela_lsp_server` and maps to `WorkspaceConfig`.
negative: Missing or malformed client response falls back to launch/config defaults.

name: Native stdio transport
positive: `--stdio`, default stdio, `--root`, `--schema`, `--version`, server info.
negative: Broken args, missing schema path, package launchers remain behavior-free.
